svg.title: Claymark — horizontal lockup (light surfaces)
svg.desc: Icon and wordmark geometry inlined directly (not referenced as sibling files via ) — nested external SVG references inside an SVG that's itself loaded via are sandboxed and don't resolve in most browsers/renderers, confirmed by testing the referenced version and finding it blank. A lockup needs to work as a single portable file, so correctness here wins over the single-source-of-truth convenience an external reference would have given. Sizing/spacing matches the proportions confirmed in LOGO-STRATEGY.md Checkpoint 7.
